title: Proportion of Fires Arising from Electrical Sources and Cooking in Homes and Commercial Premises
what_it_is: Proportion of Fires Arising from Electrical Sources and Cooking in Homes and Commercial Premises

sections.label: Residential and commercial fire causes
sections.summary: From 2023 to 2025, unattended cooking or electrical fires made up 68%, 65% and 59% of residential fires and 66%, 72% and 67% of commercial fires.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister of Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 2023 to 2025, the proportion of fires attributable to unattended cooking or electrical origin in residential premises was 68%, 65% and 59% respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister of Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The corresponding figures in commercial premises were 66%, 72% and 67% respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister of Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Over the same period, five fires in residential premises and 11 fires in commercial premises involved breaches of the Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister of Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For fires involving batteries, the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) does not track whether the batteries were compliant with the prevailing regulatory requirements.

sections.label: AMD battery fires and compliance
sections.summary: The speaker says compliance is hard to ascertain after a fire, but AMD batteries are tracked and AMD fires are under 5% of all fires with disproportionate impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: It is also sometimes very difficult to ascertain after the fire has taken place whether the particular item is compliant or not.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: But if we are talking about AMD batteries, then those are tracked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I think previously we have mentioned that AMD fires account for less than 5% of all fires, but the impact, be in terms of injuries and fatalities, is disproportionately higher, and therefore, it is something that is of concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I think recently the Ministry of Transport has moved the Bill to that regard.
